_comments.usage: Copy or move this file to ~/.config/odin/doctor/config.json
notes: The app will automatically create this file with defaults if it does not exist.
CLI flags will override any values in user_config.
This structure separates documentation from actual settings for readability.
_comments.keep: number of previous backups to retain (default 1)
_comments.install_dir: empty = auto-detect using ODIN_ROOT or 'which odin'
_comments.prefer_system_install: if true, prefer system locations like /opt/Odin
